items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Art Blakey had a very special knack for uh, uh discovering people or, you know, remembering people, and sure enough, he called me and Freddie Hubbard.

ctx.x: Well, that would be, you know …

Like uh – excuse me – like uh Killer Joe, for instance. That was all written out. Dee-dit. Ahh-bop. Like that. So uh, it was good for me in a way to uh revisit uh … 'cause with J.J., he just had little sketches which uh I do to this day. I just, I was… especially rhythm. I just, everybody in the rhythm section has the same part for most of the time, unless it's something real special I need from somebody, but uh …. So, but so, but uh, I'm not sure of … Anyway uh, it was all right, you know, I enjoyed … It was a…
